product.name: Monoprice Heavy Duty Extension Cord - IEC 60320 C20 to IEC 60320 C19 12AWG 20A SJTW 250V Black 6ft
product.description: Connect servers, routers, switches, blade servers, and other compatible C19 network devices to a PDU or UPS system. This cable features a female IEC 60320 C19 plug on one end and a male IEC 60320 C20 connector on the other end. Simply mate the male C20 connector into an AC power receptacle or rackmounted PDU or UPS system, then connect the female C19 end to a network device that requires a heavy‑gauge power cord, such as a server, router, network switch, or blade server. This cable is designed to carry up to a 20 amp/5000 watt, 250 volt load.
